input_ref: explore | Pharmacy advocate: formulary tier, can I quote a price before I verify the member?

output.reason: This unit answers the question directly: do not quote a copay, a tier, or a coverage limit to an unverified caller, and do not say whether a drug is on the formulary. A tier price cannot be given before verification. U-RX-EDU-001-06 only covers what to do when verification fails, and U-WEB-FAQ-05 is member-facing guidance on getting an estimate.
